scope: 085 boundary repair and faithful preservation of the pinned approved recitation. ASR orthography/chant pronunciation is not a verbatim listening claim.
limitations: OpenAI optional listening API unavailable: HTTP401 expired_secret_key. No success claimed for that method.

Short names, repeated words and chant are unstable in ASR; they were resolved through original-source context, independent runs, exact text/label inventory and non-speech cuts, not an ASR text equality gate.
